rationale: A single terraced ribbon mass reads consistently across the views, with a clear main bar and a smaller supporting cut/hinge. The silhouette is not primarily stair-step driven; it is more of a shallow sectional cascade. The form appears clean and repairable, with no obvious interpenetrating solids or broken fragments. The main weakness is public void: the diagram shows little spatial subtraction, courtyard logic, or undercut that would make the mass feel civic or open at ground. Precedent resonance is fair to the BIG terrace/ramp lineage without direct mimicry.
warnings: Void logic is underdeveloped; the mass reads more as a layered slab than an inhabited public section.
Could benefit from a more legible anchor or carved ground condition to strengthen spatial hierarchy.
